record: SPPPO V1 D0 seed-level uncertainty reporting decision

preexisting_smoke_outputs.status: NON_AUTHORITATIVE_8_SEED_SMOKE, expected to be replaced by the already-running 192-seed D0

scientific_delta: Reporting uncertainty only. No training, scorer fitting, gate re-scoring, new seeds, threshold changes, or method selection.

bootstrap.resampling_rule: Sample 192 seeds with replacement. Carry every decision row belonging to each sampled seed with the sampled seed multiplicity.
bootstrap.quartile_quantile_method: weighted inverted-CDF over decision rows using sampled seed multiplicities
bootstrap.cluster_protection: Decision points are never resampled independently.

worst_quartile_rule.replicate_behavior: Recompute the weighted 25th-percentile cutoff inside every seed-bootstrap replicate, then recompute all worst-quartile quantities using that replicate-local cutoff.
worst_quartile_rule.reason: Uncertainty must include both sampled-seed composition and movement of the failure-region boundary.

reported_with_seed_level_uncertainty: the same quantities in the replicate-local worst quartile
the same quantities within descriptive decision categories
three_diagnostic_questions: Does the Pole-B identity failure arise because z0 is closer to pi_B than z1?
Does Q_psi usually retain the intended z1-over-z0 ordering in the same failure region, with seed-level uncertainty?
Do bad Pole-B identity states cluster into recognizable decision categories?
non_gating_rule: No D0 statistic, confidence interval, quartile, category, or fork label is a new PASS/FAIL gate or may alter the frozen SPPPO V1 verdict.

diagnostic_interpretation_rule.status: diagnostic language only, never a gate

wording_rule.optimization_favored: The evidence favors optimization/interference over scorer misranking as the dominant failure mode.

execution_rule: Allow the live D0 replay to finish unchanged. Apply this frozen reporting analysis afterward to its complete raw decision-row artifact; do not recollect or rerun episodes.
